property_summary: For every call to transfer(...), the reference contract always reverts when the recipient array `_tos` is empty (so no external calls occur), whereas the mutant accepts empty `_tos` and can return true without making any external calls — i.e., reference: empty `_tos` -> transfer reverts; mutant: some empty `_tos` -> transfer succeeds.
change_summary: Change the require that ensures _tos.length > 0 to require _tos.length >= 0 (always true) so transfer can accept empty _tos without reverting.
